photos.title: Grande Shores, an oceanfront condo resort in Myrtle Beach, from the beach
photos.what: A ten-story oceanfront resort building seen from the sand at dusk, rows of balconies with white chairs, dune grass and a beach walkover in front, a taller condo tower on the left. No readable sign, logo, person or plate.
photos.caption: Grande Shores, an oceanfront condo resort in Myrtle Beach, from the beach.
photos.alt: An oceanfront condo resort with rows of balconies, seen from the beach at dusk
